sections.label: Cybersecurity news & advisories
sections.summary: 5/8 public sources refreshed successfully in the latest run; community posts are labelled unverified signals.

sections.label: LiveOps public problem-source radar
sections.cadence: Every 6 hours after workflow is enabled
sections.summary: Source discovery and candidate records; these are not automatically certified as publish-ready challenges.

sections.label: Resource, video and external-link reachability
sections.summary: A responding URL does not prove a course is free, accessible, safe, current, or educationally accurate.

sections.label: Certification and exam source links
sections.cadence: Daily source monitor; weekly resource review
sections.summary: Monitors page reachability and content change signals; exam terms and pricing still require issuer confirmation.

sections.label: Career paths, modules and prerequisites
sections.summary: Check new skill requirements, outdated tools, role expectations, prerequisite order, and original-source references. Record a date only after a human review.

sections.label: Operating systems and DistroSea catalogue
sections.summary: Review supported OS names, versions and online availability against the provider. A prior catalogue snapshot is not proof that a session is currently available.

sections.label: Video and tutorial accuracy (separate from link health)
sections.summary: Check whether instructions and screenshots still match current versions; a working URL alone is not an accuracy review.

sections.label: CTF learning-directory access notes and rules
sections.summary: Review access conditions, platform rules and official links. Do not label a time-sensitive event live without current organizer data.

sections.label: CyberRange, CTF Arcade and lab fixtures
sections.summary: Re-run challenge checks, verify answer keys, keep sample data synthetic, and test that solutions remain reproducible.

sections.label: Offline study pack and cached learning material
sections.summary: Verify that standalone packs match current lessons and that the deployed app refreshes the cache after releases.

sections.label: Public cyber-safety guidance and reporting references
sections.summary: Recheck official reporting channels and guidance; keep emergency/financial-fraud instructions sourced from official agencies.
